_doc: 31 shots, 1860 frames at 24 fps. Frames are global. Camera keys use local frame f within the shot. pos/look are [x,y,z] or {anchor, off}. fov in degrees, number or [start,end]. ease: inout|linear|in|out. shake: list of {start,end,amp,freq} in local frames, amp in metres. shadowSize: width of the sun shadow camera in metres (small for close-ups). haze: 0..1 ochre dust haze. notes tell each department what must be on screen.

shots.name: Establishing
shots.cue: calm town, warm strings, a faint uneasy tremolo under

notes.town: whole town, domes, bell towers, wall and gate, fields and mountains beyond
notes.fx: a few drifting laundry lines, swallows optional
notes.characters: tiny crowd dots in the square (instanced)

shots.name: Street with mothers
shots.cue: calm, woodwind phrase, lazy afternoon

notes.town: cross street z=110 looking west: cubic houses, cobalt doors, laundry lines across, bougainvillea, striped awning
notes.characters: badger mother with piglet at a cobalt door (MOTHERS.badger.shot2), goat mother with baby crossing the street slowly
notes.fx: laundry sway, dust motes

shots.name: Kids on the canal steps
shots.cue: calm, cello line, a pizzicato pebble

notes.characters: fox kid tosses a pebble into the canal, hare kid with round glasses sits hugging knees, lynx kid leans back calmly; the wall is behind them
notes.town: canal steps, water, wall and gate in background
notes.fx: pebble splash ring on 2s at local f 40

shots.name: Hare kid uneasy
shots.cue: uneasy, high strings, single harp note

notes.characters: hare kid close: glasses, big wet eyes, ears twitch once, looks up toward the wall (screen left-back)
notes.town: soft background of the wall

shots.name: Low angle wall and gate
shots.cue: silence creeping in, low drone

notes.town: wall towering, gate with sun carving, crenellations, towers; houses frame the edges
notes.fx: nothing yet; sky with cumulus

shots.name: Bolt
shots.cue: HUGE hit at f0 then ringing silence

notes.fx: cyan bolt from the zenith striking beyond the wall at x=0 z=-60; frame goes white at f0-f2, bolt holds f2-f8 as inked jagged shape, afterglow
notes.town: square foreground, wall behind

shots.name: Dome of light
shots.cue: ringing silence, a sub rumble building

notes.fx: hemisphere of pale cyan light rising behind the wall, expanding, with concentric inked rings; cloud of debris lifting

shots.name: Shock wave over roofs
shots.cue: the shock wave: a bass drum and cymbal wash, then wind

notes.fx: visible ring of displaced air sweeping toward camera over roof terraces at f8-f30, roof tiles lift, laundry whips, awning tears, dust puffs
notes.town: roofscape with domes, laundry lines, awnings

shots.name: Kids blown back
shots.cue: wind roar decaying

notes.characters: fox kid throws himself over the hare kid shielding him, lynx kid braces with a hand on the step; fur and ears blown toward +z (camera)
notes.fx: dust streaming past, leaves

shots.name: Column of steam
shots.cue: ringing silence, heartbeat begins, low dread

notes.fx: a vast column of white steam rising behind the wall from z=-50, inked billows, growing from 60 m to 200 m over the shot
notes.characters: backs of townsfolk in the main street foreground looking up (silhouette-dark cel)
notes.town: main street toward the gate

shots.name: Square frozen
shots.cue: heartbeat, dread strings, no melody

notes.characters: crowd of bears, deer, dogs, sheep, raccoons, otters, boars in the square, all looking up past camera toward the wall, a dropped basket
notes.town: square, bell towers behind

shots.name: The hand
shots.cue: STINGER at f4 (global 640): brass hit, timpani, then rumble

notes.giant: bronze hand (verdigris plates, gold edges) comes down from above frame and slams onto the wall top at handImpact at local f4; fingers grip over the crenellations; steam vents from the knuckles
notes.fx: cracks spider through the sandstone from the hand, crenellation blocks fall toward the town side, dust
notes.town: wall section near x=30

shots.name: Lynx kid
shots.cue: heartbeat, dust falling

notes.characters: lynx kid calm, eyes narrow, ear tufts; looks toward the wall (screen right-back)
notes.fx: fine dust drifting down

shots.name: The head rises
shots.cue: minor choir enters, brass swell building to f84

notes.giant: the round mask rises over the wall from behind (sightline from this camera clears y about 61 at the giant's z, so the head shows from local f35 and stands fully above the wall by f84); slit dark at first then glowing from 796; steam pours from the neck and shoulders
notes.fx: steam billows around the head
notes.town: very low angle down the main street from z 142: houses either side, the wall and gate at the end, the head appears above the wall

shots.name: The mask
shots.cue: choir and brass peak, then hold

notes.giant: close on the mask: round, verdigris plates with gold rims, the single vertical slit glowing cyan-white with a pulse; steam from neck joints
notes.fx: steam, heat shimmer optional

shots.name: Looking down at the town
shots.cue: hold, slow strings

notes.town: the giant's view: the wall top in foreground, the whole town below, canal steps with the tiny kids
notes.characters: kids tiny on the steps looking up

shots.name: Crowd faces
shots.cue: strings thin out

notes.characters: bear, deer, dog, sheep faces frozen, mouths open, eyes up past camera; a raccoon drops a jug

shots.name: Head turns to the gate
shots.cue: everything fades to near-silence by f60

notes.giant: head and shoulders above the wall, the mask turns slowly down to look at the gate, steam
notes.fx: steam thinning

shots.name: The leg lifts
shots.cue: near-total silence; a single breath of steam

notes.giant: from the wall top: the giant's lower body outside, right leg lifts, knee vents steam, foot draws back and up
notes.town: wall top, towers, fields and mountains beyond

shots.name: Kick
shots.cue: IMPACT at f8 (global 1112): bass drum, tam-tam, anvil, brass cluster

notes.giant: foot swings forward and smashes into the gate at f8
notes.fx: impact flash f8-f10, gate doors buckle inward, stone blocks of the arch burst toward +z, dust
notes.town: intact gate hidden from f8, broken pieces take over (same place)

shots.name: Gate explodes inward
shots.cue: chaos percussion; whoosh of pieces passing camera

notes.fx: door panels (sun-carved) and boulders fly over camera toward the town, trails of dust; the dust wall begins at the gate
notes.giant: foot visible through the breach, then withdrawing
notes.town: main street, breach

shots.name: Boulders on the roofs
shots.cue: percussion hit on every landing: T.BOULDER_LANDINGS 1190 1203 1219 1236

notes.fx: boulders arc in from the gate and land on terraces at 1190, 1203, 1219; at 1236 one shatters the turquoise dome at (-18, 55); debris and dust bursts on each landing
notes.town: roofscape between gate and square

shots.name: The facade falls
shots.cue: hit at 1247, then rolling percussion, falling stone

notes.town: HERO_HOUSE: boulder hits the roof at 1247; the +x facade peels away in slabs and falls into the street by 1296, interior rooms visible (cobalt shutters swinging)
notes.fx: dust burst from the collapse, debris
notes.characters: two townsfolk running toward camera in the street

shots.name: Run from the dust
shots.cue: chaos percussion, strings sawing, boulder hits at 1301 1322 1341

notes.characters: crowd runs toward camera (+z) down the main street: bears, deer, dogs, sheep, raccoons, otters, boars, on 2s run cycles, some fall and get up
notes.fx: wall of ochre dust advancing behind them from z=20 to z=60, boulders landing on roofs either side
notes.town: main street

shots.name: Mothers
shots.cue: boulder hit at 1372, lament begins faintly under the percussion

notes.characters: badger mother scoops up her piglet and runs; goat mother clutching her baby runs behind; MOTHERS.*.shot25
notes.fx: a boulder lands behind them at 1372 with a dust burst, dust haze thick

shots.name: Up the steps
shots.cue: lament rising, percussion receding

notes.characters: fox kid hauls the hare kid up the canal steps by the arm; the hare kid stumbles; the lynx kid at the top looks back toward the gate
notes.fx: dust drifting across, ash

shots.name: The giant dissolves
shots.cue: low lament, choir far away

notes.giant: full figure above the wall, standing still; from T.DISSOLVE_START its plates fade and fray into steam (dithered dissolve), gone by 1560
notes.fx: steam bursting from every joint, rising and spreading; ochre dust hanging over the town
notes.town: whole town, breach in the wall at the gate

shots.name: The breach
shots.cue: lament; distant slow metallic footsteps

notes.town: down the main street to the shattered gate; broken arch stones
notes.fx: steam clearing, backlit dust
notes.giant: small automatons (14 m) silhouetted in the fields walking toward the breach, steam from their joints

shots.name: They walk in
shots.cue: lament; footsteps closer, metal creak

notes.giant: two small automatons step through the breach past the ruined gate, slow mechanical gait on 2s, steam
notes.fx: dust, falling grit
notes.town: breach interior, ruined doors

shots.name: The hare kid
shots.cue: low lament, solo cello

notes.characters: the hare kid standing at the top of the steps (anchor hareHead applies; characters dept moves hare to this standing pose for shots 30-31 and keeps head within 10 cm of ANCHORS.hareHead), glasses askew, wet trembling eyes, mouth slightly open, a tear forming
notes.fx: ash drifting

shots.name: Eyes, then black
shots.cue: lament resolves on a held low note; cut to black at 1812; silence tail

notes.characters: the eyes fill the frame; a tear runs at local f20; blink at f40
notes.fx: picture cuts to black at global 1812 (core handles)
